people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Jehovah, died, being a hundred and ten years old.
